1. # **Introduction**

   1. ## **Purpose**

The primary objective of this document is to provide a detailed explanation about GameGuessr. GameGuessr is a website-based quiz game. This document outlines the purpose, features, system interfaces, functionalities and limitations of GameGuessr. It is intended to serve as a crucial roadmap for developers and stakeholders, ensuring effective collaboration and communication throughout the development process. By providing a clear scope about the projects' objectives, this document aims to facilitate seamless development, testing, integration and deployment of the website. In addition, this document serves as a reference for future modifications and improvements, as the system will adapt continuously according to the user feedback. It will be submitted to Binus for its approval.

The release version of GameGuessr is 1.0.0-MVP. The development cycle consists of 4 phases and each phase will be conducted within 1 month. The SRS scope of this product includes 3 main subsystems which are the uploader module, quiz module, and leaderboard module. The development process will be done using an incremental process model, allowing iterative improvement and adaptation at each phase.

2. ## **Document Conventions**

This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) follows the IEEE 830-1998 standard structure for software requirements documentation. The following conventions used throughout this document are as follows:

**Typographical Conventions**  
This section outlines specific visual styles which are used to highlight different types of technical information.

| Element | Convention | Example |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Requirement ID | Bold alphanumeric code | **REQ-QUIZ-1** |
| Software Modules | Title Case & Bold | The **Uploader Module** shall… |
| User Interface (UI) | Open Sans Bold | Click the **Submit Quiz** button |
| Data / Variables | Monospaced font (Google sans code) | user\_score, leaderboard\_rank |
| Priority Level | Bold within brackets | \[**High**\], \[**Medium**\], \[**Low**\] |
| Emphasis | Italicized text | This action is *irreversible* |

**Requirement Priority and Inheritance**  
The following rules explains how the requirements in GameGuessr are prioritized by using an incremental process model.

- Priority Inheritance: High level requirements set the baseline priority. All detailed sub-requirements within that module *inherit* the high-level priority unless specifically overridden.  
- Unique Tagging: Every individual requirement statement must have its own unique ID (e.g., **REQ-QUIZ-1**) to facilitate testing and integration across all 4 phases.

**Requirement Statements**  
This section follows the standards of IEEE 830-1998 terminology to define the necessity of every feature.

- Shall: A mandatory requirement for the 1.0.0-MVP release (High level requirements)  
- Should: A recommended feature  
- May: An optional feature that may be added based on user feedback.


  3. ## **Intended Audience and Reading Suggestions**

	This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) is intended for all parties involved in the design, development, testing, deployment, and evaluation of GameGuessr. The document is organized to support a wide range of readers with different levels of technical expertise. The following outlines the recommended reading approach for each reader type:

- **Developers and Software Engineers**  
  They should read this document in its entirety, with extra focus on Section 3 (External Interface Requirements) and Section 4 (System Features) for implementation specifications, and Section 5 (Other Nonfunctional Requirements) for quality and performance standards.  
- **Project Managers**  
  To fully understand the project’s objectives and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), it is recommended to focus on Section 1 (Introduction) and Section 2 (Overall Description) to understand the project scope, constraints, and assumptions relevant to planning and risk management.  
- **Quality Assurance (QA) Testers**  
  They should prioritize Section 4 (System Features) for test case development, supported by Section 3 and Section 5 for interface and non-functional validation. Appendix C (To Be Determined List) should be monitored for deferred items affecting test coverage.  
- **Documentation Writers**  
  They should treat this document as a baseline reference for GameGuessr’s original scope. They should read Sections 1 through 2 for the foundational concept, while actively referring to Appendices A through C.  
- **Stakeholders and Non-Technical Readers**  
  For readers with a limited technical background, such as marketing staff and end users, it is suggested that they focus on Section 1 (Introduction) and Section 2 (Overall Description) to gain a sufficient understanding of the software’s purpose and scope. 


The remainder of this document is organized as follows. Section 2 (Overall Description), of this document gives an overview of the functionality of the product. It describes the informal requirements and is used to establish a context for the technical requirement specifications in the next chapter. Section 3 (External Interface Requirement) of this document details the logical and physical characteristics of the system's user, hardware, software, and communications interfaces of GameGuessr. Section 4 (System Features) is the most technical as it describes the precise functional requirements of GameGuessr’s three core subsystems. Section 5 (Other NonFunctional Requirements) explains performance benchmarks, security constraints, safety considerations, and software quality attributes. Section 6 (Other Requirements) captures any remaining legal, regulatory, or domain-specific requirements. The document concludes with 3 appendices: Appendix A (Glossary), Appendix B (Analysis Models), and Appendix C (To Be Determined List).

4. ## **Product Scope**

GameGuessr is a web-based interactive quiz game platform designed to make learning and knowledge testing more engaging, competitive, and accessible. The platform enables users to participate in quiz sessions generated from uploaded content, competing against others in real time and tracking performance through a dynamic leaderboard system.

The core objective is to bridge the gap between content sharing and interactive assessment by allowing uploaders to convert their materials into quiz questions, which other users can then answer within a timed, game-like environment. This approach transforms passive content consumption into an active, competitive experience that reinforces knowledge retention.

GameGuessr is structured around three primary subsystems:

- **Uploader Module**  
  → Allows designated users to submit content and configure quiz parameters.  
- **Quiz Module**  
  → Delivers questions to participants, manages session timing, records responses.  
- **Leaderboard Module**  
  → aggregates scores and ranks participants, providing a transparent and motivating competitive layer.


From a strategic standpoint, GameGuessr addresses the growing demand for gamified educational and entertainment tools in digital environments. Its incremental development model ensures that the platform can adapt based on user feedback across its four development phases, with the initial release (v1.0.0-MVP) focusing on delivering a stable, functional core experience.

The platform is intended for two primary user groups: content uploaders who wish to share and test knowledge, and quiz participants seeking an engaging, competitive experience. GameGuessr does not aim to replace formal learning management systems but instead serves as a lightweight, gamified complement to existing educational or entertainment ecosystems.

2. # **Overall Description**

   1. ## **Product Perspective**

GameGuessr is a new, self‑contained, web‑based application. It is not a follow‑on to any existing product nor a replacement for a legacy system. It is designed to operate independently, with no mandatory integration with external platforms or third-party AI APIs .

**System Architecture Context**

GameGuessr follows a three‑tier client‑server architecture:

* **Presentation Tier (Frontend):** Single-Page Application (SPA) built with React 18 and Vite 8.x as the build tool. It runs entirely in the user's browser and communicates with the backend via HTTP REST API. The UI uses a custom glassmorphism dark-mode design system with Plus Jakarta Sans and Outfit typography, without Material-UI.

* **Application Tier (Backend):** Node.js 22 LTS with Express.js providing RESTful APIs. Real-time communication is handled by Socket.io for timer synchronization and quiz session management.

* **Data Tier:** MySQL 8.4 relational database for persistent storage. File uploads (content files and game cover images) are stored on the server's local filesystem.

* **Tech Stack Details:**

| Component | Technology & Version | Justification |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Frontend Framework | React 18 \+ Vite 8.x | Component reusability, fast HMR dev server, virtual DOM for performance. |
| UI Design System | Custom CSS (Glassmorphism) | Premium dark-mode design with glass panels, micro-animations, and dynamic hover effects. No MUI dependency. |
| Typography | Plus Jakarta Sans \+ Outfit | Modern premium typography via Google Fonts. |
| State Management | React Context API \+ useState | Sufficient for MVP complexity; avoids Redux boilerplate. |
| Internationalization | Custom i18n (JSON-based) | Bilingual support (Bahasa Indonesia \+ English) with runtime language switching. |
| Backend Runtime | Node.js 22.12.0 LTS | Non-blocking I/O ideal for real-time apps; large package ecosystem. |
| API Framework | Express 4.x | Minimalist, fast, and widely supported. |
| Real-time Library | Socket.io 4.x | Automatic fallback to long-polling; built-in room support for quiz sessions. |
| Database | MySQL 8.4 | ACID compliance, strong community, and familiarity within the development team. |
| Authentication | JWT (jsonwebtoken) \+ bcryptjs | Stateless auth with HS256 signing and password hashing at cost factor 10\. |
| File Upload | Multer | Middleware for handling multipart/form-data file uploads. |
| PDF Parsing | pdf-parse | Extract text from PDF uploads for quiz generation. |
| DOCX Parsing | mammoth | Extract text from DOCX uploads for quiz generation. |
| Security | Helmet \+ express-rate-limit \+ CORS | HTTP security headers, rate limiting, and cross-origin configuration. |

  2. ## **Product Functions**

The following is a high‑level summary of the major functions GameGuessr must perform. Detailed specifications appear in Section 4\.

* **FUN‑01: User Account Management**  
  Users can create an account, log in, log out, and update basic profile information (display name, avatar URL). The system supports three distinct roles: Participant, Uploader, and Administrator.

* **FUN‑02: Content Upload & Quiz Creation**  
  Uploaders can submit a structured text file (.txt), PDF, DOCX, or JSON file containing questions. The system parses the content using a deterministic text parser (no AI/API dependency) and generates a set of multiple-choice questions. Uploaders can edit, add, or delete parsed questions, set a time limit per question (15–120 seconds), and publish the quiz. The system supports bilingual quiz content (Bahasa Indonesia \+ English) via the Question\_EN/A\_EN/B\_EN/C\_EN/D\_EN fields in the .txt format.

* **FUN‑03: Real‑Time Quiz Participation**  
  Participants can browse a list of available quizzes (with category tag filtering), join a quiz session, and answer questions one by one against a synchronized timer. The system records answers instantly, calculates a running score (+1,000 points per correct answer), shows immediate visual and audio feedback after each question, displays streak combo animations for consecutive correct answers (≥3x), and renders a victory confetti animation upon completion.

* **FUN‑04: Leaderboard and Performance Tracking**  
  Upon quiz completion, the participant's score is posted to a global leaderboard for that quiz. Participants can view leaderboards (with medal indicators 🥇🥈🥉), their own quiz history, and summary statistics (average score, total quizzes taken, highest score, total points).

* **FUN‑05: Administrative Moderation**  
  Administrators can view all users, promote/demote user roles, soft-delete users, hide or delete inappropriate quizzes, and view system-wide usage statistics. All administrative actions are logged in an audit\_log table.

  3. ## **User Classes and Characteristics**

GameGuessr identifies four primary user classes. Each class differs in terms of access privileges, frequency of use, and technical expertise required.

The system distinguishes four user classes based on privilege level and intended use. The following table provides detailed characteristics.

| User Class | Privilege Level | Frequency of Use | Technical Expertise | Key Responsibilities / Use Cases | Importance to MVP |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Guest** | None | Occasional | Basic web browsing | View landing page, register for an account. | Low |
| **Participant** | Low | Regular (daily) | Basic \- can click and type | Browse quizzes, join sessions, answer questions, view personal history and leaderboards. | **Critical** |
| **Uploader** | Medium | Weekly / Monthly | Intermediate \- comfortable with file uploads | Upload structured .txt files, create and edit quizzes, monitor performance. | High |
| **Administrator** | Highest | As needed | Advanced \- understands system operations | Manage user accounts and roles, moderate content, view usage reports. | Medium (Support) |

**Special Notes:**

* A **Participant** can be promoted to **Uploader** only by an Administrator.  
* All registered users are Participants by default.  
* The Administrator account is pre‑seeded during deployment; no self‑registration to Admin role is possible.

  5. ## **Design and Implementation Constraints**

The following constraints must be observed throughout development and deployment. 

* **C‑01: Browser‑Only Client**  
  No native iOS or Android application will be developed for the MVP. All user interaction occurs via a web browser. 

* **C‑02: WebSocket Dependency**  
  Real-time question delivery, timer sync, and answer submission require a persistent WebSocket connection. Socket.io will fall back to HTTP long-polling if WebSocket is blocked. 

* **C‑03: File Upload Size Limit**  
  Uploaded content files shall not exceed 10 MB per the SRS specification and Multer configuration. 

* **C‑04: Single Language Interface**  
  The user interface supports both Bahasa Indonesia and English with runtime language switching. Quiz content can be authored in both languages using the \_EN suffix fields in the .txt upload format. 

* **C‑05: Incremental Development Phases**  
  The quiz generation system uses a deterministic text parser (parseStructuredText) to extract questions from uploaded .txt files. All processing is local and offline-capable. 

* **C‑06: Single‑Server Architecture**  
  The entire application stack (Node.js API, WebSocket server, MySQL) runs on a single machine. This simplifies deployment and cost but limits horizontal scalability. 

* **C‑07: No Third‑Party Authentication**  
  The MVP does not support OAuth (Google, Facebook) login. Only email/password registration is implemented. 

* **C‑08: File Storage \- Local Filesystem**  
  Uploaded files and game cover images are stored on the server's local disk.

7. ## **Assumptions and Dependencies**

**2.7.1 Assumptions**

* AS-01: Users have access to a device with a modern browser and a stable internet connection.

* AS-02: Uploaders will use the structured .txt format (Question:/A:/B:/C:/D:/Answer:) for quiz creation. No AI-based auto-generation is available.

* AS-03: The MySQL database will be available 99.9% of the time during operational hours.

* AS-04: Peak concurrent users will not exceed 100 during MVP.

* AS-05: The development team has proficiency in JavaScript, React, Node.js, and MySQL.

**2.7.2 Dependencies**

| Dependency | Version | Purpose | Impact if Unavailable |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Socket.io** | 4.7.5 | Real‑time communication | Quiz Module becomes non‑functional; fallback to polling degrades UX. |
| **React** | 19.2.6 | Frontend UI rendering | Application cannot be built or run. |
| **Express** | 4.19.2 | REST API framework | Backend API unavailable. |
| **MySQL** | 8.4 | Persistent data storage | No user data, quizzes, or scores can be saved or retrieved. |
| **bcryptjs** | 2.4.3 | Password hashing | Security vulnerability; plaintext passwords would be unacceptable. |
| **jsonwebtoken** | 9.0.2 | JWT generation and verification | Authentication breaks; users cannot log in. |
| **Multer** | 1.4.5-lts.1 | File upload handling | Upload Module cannot accept files. |
| **pdf‑parse** | 1.1.1 | Extract text from PDF uploads | PDF uploads fail to generate questions. |
| **mammoth** | 1.6.0 | Extract text from DOCX uploads | DOCX uploads fail to generate questions. |
| **Nginx** | 1.24.0 | Reverse proxy and SSL termination | Production deployment security and routing would be suboptimal. |

3. # **External Interface Requirements**

   1. ## **User Interfaces** {#user-interfaces}

The GameGuessr UI is a responsive web application built with React and a custom CSS design system featuring glassmorphism aesthetics, dark mode, and micro-animations. All pages share a common layout structure.

**3.1.1 Common Layout Elements**

| Element | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Header** | Contains the GameGuessr logo (links to home), main navigation (Quizzes, Leaderboard, Create Quiz if Uploader), and a user avatar dropdown (Profile, My History, Logout). |
| **Footer** | Contains links to About, FAQ, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Contact. |
| **Notification Area** | A Snackbar (MUI) component that displays success, error, info, and warning messages for 5 seconds. All system feedback appears here. |
| **Loading Spinner** | A circular progress indicator displayed during API calls or WebSocket connection establishment. |

**3.1.2 Page‑Specific UI Specifications**

**A. Landing Page (Guest View)**

* **Hero Section**: Large "GameGuessr" title with text-glow effect, sub-headline, and action buttons ("Play Now", "Leaderboard").

* **Daily Challenge**: A rotating daily quiz card with cover image, description, and "Start Challenge" button.

* **Category Filter Pills**: Clickable pill buttons to filter quizzes by category tags (e.g., FPS, RPG, Sandbox).

* **Quiz Grid**: Cards showing game cover image, title, description, tags, question count, and "Play" button. Each card features glassmorphism styling with hover animations.

* **Top Players Sidebar**: A side panel showing the top 5 global players with avatar, display name, and total score.

**D. Quiz Participation Interface**

* **Header Bar:** Displays Quiz Title, current question number (e.g., “Question 5/10”), and a prominent countdown timer (format MM:SS).  
* **Question Area:** Large, readable text for the question stem.  
* **Answer Options:** Four radio‑button style cards (A, B, C, D). Only one may be selected.  
* **Action Button:** “Submit Answer”. This button is disabled until an option is selected. Once submitted, the button changes to “Next Question” (or “Finish Quiz” on the last question).  
* **Feedback Overlay:** After submitting, a green (correct) or red (incorrect) banner appears for 1.5 seconds showing the result before automatically advancing to the next question.  
* **Disconnection Handling:** If WebSocket disconnects, a modal overlay appears: “Connection lost. Attempting to reconnect…” with a spinner. When reconnected, the quiz resumes from the last unanswered question.

2. ## **Hardware Interfaces**

GameGuessr does not interface directly with any specialized hardware peripherals. It relies entirely on standard input/output devices managed by the operating system and browser.

* **Input Devices**: Keyboard, mouse, touchscreen (on mobile devices).

* **Output Devices**: Display monitor/screen, speakers/headphones (for audio feedback and background music).

* **No Direct Hardware Control**: The application does not access device sensors beyond what the browser sandbox permits (e.g., LocalStorage for caching preferences).

  3. ## **Software Interfaces**

This section details the interfaces between GameGuessr and external software components or libraries.

**3.3.1 Database Interface – MySQL**

| Attribute | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **DBMS** | MySQL 8.4  |
| **Connection Method** | mysql2 Node.js driver (promise‑based) |
| **Connection Pool** | connectionLimit: 20, waitForConnections: true, charset: utf8mb4  |
| **Authentication** | Username/password stored in environment variables. No hard‑coded credentials. |
| **Data Exchange** | SQL queries and result sets. Parameterized queries used exclusively to prevent SQL injection. |
| **Port** | 3306 (default, internal network only) |

**3.3.2 File System Interface**

| Attribute | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Storage Location** | /uploads/ (content files), /uploads/games/ (cover images) |
| **File Naming** | {timestamp}-{original\_filename} to prevent collisions  |
| **Access** | Uploaded files are served statically via Express static middleware  |
| **Size Limit**  | 10 MB per file (enforced by Multer)  |

**3.3.3 Third‑Party Libraries (NPM)**

All libraries are managed via package.json. Key runtime dependencies:

| Library | Version | Interface Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **express** | 4.19.2 | Provides HTTP server and middleware routing. |
| **socket.io** | 4.7.5 | Attaches to the HTTP server to provide WebSocket functionality. Exports io object for event handling. |
| **jsonwebtoken** | 9.0.2 | jwt.sign() and jwt.verify() used for token management. |
| **bcryptjs** | 2.4.3 | bcryptjs.hash() and bcryptjs.compare() for password handling. |
| **multer** | 1.4.5 | Middleware for handling multipart/form-data file uploads. |
| **pdf‑parse** | 1.1.1 | Function pdf(dataBuffer) returns a promise with text content. |
| **mammoth** | 1.6.0 | mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer }) returns a promise with text. |
| **express‑rate-limit**  | 7.2.0 | Middleware for validating and sanitizing request bodies. |
| **helmet** | 7.1.0 | Sets various HTTP headers for security. |
| **cors** | 2.8.5 | Configures Cross‑Origin Resource Sharing for API endpoints. |

**3.3.4 Frontend Dependencies**

| Library | Version | Interface Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **react** | 19.2.6 | Core UI library. |
| **react‑router‑dom** | 7.15.0 | Client‑side routing. |
| **lucide-react**  | 1.14.0  | Provides clean, lightweight, and customizable SVG vector icons as React components  |

4. ## **Communications Interfaces**

**3.4.1 REST API over HTTPS**

* **Protocol**: HTTP (HTTPS in production with TLS 1.2+).  
* **Base URL**: http://localhost:5000/api (development)  
* **Authentication**: All endpoints except /auth/register and /auth/login require a valid JWT in the Authorization: Bearer \<token\> header.  
* **Request**/**Response** **Format**: JSON (Content-Type: application/json).  
* **Rate Limiting**: Implemented using express-rate-limit. Default: 100 requests per IP per 15 minutes.

**3.4.2 WebSocket Communication (Socket.io)**

* **Protocol:** WSS (WebSocket Secure) over the same port as HTTPS (443).  
* **Connection URL:** wss://api.GameGuessr.app/socket.io/  
* **Authentication:** The Socket.io connection is authenticated using the same JWT sent as a query parameter or in the auth handshake object.  
* **Namespaces / Rooms:**  
  * Each quiz session is mapped to a **Socket.io room** named quiz:{quizId}:{sessionId}.  
  * Participants join the room upon starting a quiz.  
  * The server emits events to the room to synchronize timers and advance questions.  
* **Event Schema (Server → Client):**  
  * question:new – payload: { questionId, text, options, timeLimit, questionNumber, totalQuestions }  
  * timer:sync – payload: { remainingSeconds } (sent every second)  
  * answer:result – payload: { correct, correctAnswerId, scoreDelta }  
  * quiz:completed – payload: { finalScore, totalQuestions, leaderboardRank }  
  * error – payload: { code, message }  
* **Event Schema (Client → Server):**  
  * answer:submit – payload: { questionId, answerId }  
  * quiz:leave – payload: { } (graceful disconnect)

**3.4.3 Email Communication (Optional for MVP)**

* **Purpose:** Send account verification and password reset emails.  
* **Implementation:** If implemented, the system will use **Nodemailer** with an SMTP relay (e.g., SendGrid, AWS SES).  
* **Message Format:** HTML emails with a plain‑text fallback.  
* **Security:** All links in emails will use HTTPS and include a time‑limited, single‑use token.

4. # **System Features**

## This section organizes functional requirements by major features. Each requirement is uniquely identified and prioritized.

1. ## **Authentication and Authorization** 

**4.1.1 Description and Priority**

This feature manages user identity, session management, and access control based on roles. It is the foundational security component of GameGuessr.

**Priority:** **High** – Without it, no other features can function securely.

**4.1.2 Stimulus/Response Sequences**

| Actor | Action | System Response |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Guest** | Submits registration form with valid data. | 1\. Validates input. 2\. Checks email/username uniqueness. 3\. Hashes password (bcryptjs, salt factor 10). 4\. Inserts user record with role 'participant'. 5\. Returns 201 Created with JWT token and user info. |
| **Guest** | Submits registration with existing email. | Returns 400 Bad Request with error "Email already exists". |
| **User** | Submits login form with valid credentials. | 1\. Finds user by email. 2\. Compares password with bcryptjs. 3\. Generates JWT (expires in 24h). 4\. Returns 200 OK with token and user profile. |
| **User** | Submits login with invalid credentials. | Returns 401 Unauthorized: "The email or password you entered is incorrect." |
| **User** | Logs out. | Client discards JWT from localStorage. Server does not maintain state. |
| **Participant** | Attempts to access admin endpoint. | Server middleware checks role claim in JWT. Returns 403 Forbidden if role ≠ admin. |
| **Admin** | Promotes a user to Uploader. | 1\. Validates admin token. 2\. Updates user's role to 'uploader'. 3\. Logs action in audit\_log. 4\. Returns 200 OK. |

**4.1.3 Functional Requirements**

* **REQ-AUTH-001 \[High\]:** The system shall provide an endpoint POST /api/auth/register that accepts username, email, and password.  
* **REQ-AUTH-002 \[High\]:** The system shall enforce that the username is unique, alphanumeric, and between 3 and 20 characters.  
* **REQ-AUTH-003 \[High\]:** The system shall enforce that email is a valid email format and unique.  
* **REQ-AUTH-004 \[High\]:** The system shall enforce that the password is at least 8 characters long and contains at least one letter and one number.  
* **REQ-AUTH-005 \[High\]:** The system shall hash all user passwords using bcryptjs with a salt factor of 10 before storage.  
* **REQ-AUTH-006 \[High\]:** The system shall provide an endpoint POST /api/auth/login that accepts email and password and returns a signed JWT.  
* **REQ-AUTH-007 \[High\]:** The JWT payload shall include userId, username, email, role, avatar\_url, and display\_name. The token shall expire after 24 hours.  
* **REQ-AUTH-008 \[High\]:** All protected API endpoints shall require a valid JWT in the Authorization header. Missing or invalid tokens shall result in 401 Unauthorized.  
* **REQ-AUTH-009 \[High\]:** The system shall implement role-based middleware: requireAuth (any authenticated user), requireUploader (uploader or admin), requireAdmin (admin only).  
* **REQ-AUTH-010 \[High\]:** The system shall provide GET /api/auth/me to retrieve the current user's profile information.  
* **REQ-AUTH-011 \[High\]:** The system shall provide PATCH /api/auth/profile to update display\_name and avatar\_url, returning a new JWT with updated claims 

  2. ## **Uploader Module \- Content Upload and Quiz Configuration**

**4.2.1 Description and Priority**

This feature enables users with the Uploader role to submit content files, have them parsed into quiz questions, configure quiz parameters, and publish the quiz for participants.

**Priority:** **High** – Content is the fuel for the platform.

**4.2.2 Stimulus/Response Sequences**

| Actor | Action | System Response |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Uploader** | Uploads a valid .txt file. | 1\. Saves file temporarily.2\. Extracts text.3\. Parses with parseStructuredText().4\. Returns parsed questions to the frontend editor. |
| **Uploader** | Uploads a .pdf file. | 1\. Extracts text with pdf-parse.2\. Parses extracted text.3\. Returns parsed questions. |
| **Uploader** | Uploads a .docx file. | 1\. Extracts text with mammoth.2\. Parses extracted text.3\. Returns parsed questions. |
| **Uploader** | Uploads a .json file. | 1\. Parses JSON directly.2\. Maps to question objects.3\. Returns questions. |
| **Uploader** | Uploads a file larger than 10 MB. | Multer rejects file. Returns 413 Payload Too Large. |
| **Uploader** | Clicks "Publish Quiz" after configuring. | 1\. Validates title and ≥1 question.2\. Saves quiz and questions to database.3\. Returns 201 Created with quizId. |

**4.2.3 Functional Requirements**

**File Upload & Parsing**

* **REQ-UPLOAD-001 \[High\]:** The system shall accept file uploads via POST /api/upload/upload with multipart/form-data. Supported formats: .txt, .pdf, .docx, .json.  
* **REQ-UPLOAD-002 \[High\]:** The system shall enforce a maximum file size of 10 MB.  
* **REQ-UPLOAD-003 \[High\]:** For .txt files, the system shall apply a structured text parser that extracts Question/A/B/C/D/Answer fields (including bilingual \_EN variants).  
* **REQ-UPLOAD-004 \[Medium\]:** The system shall allow Uploaders to upload a JSON file with directly defined questions.  
* **REQ-UPLOAD-005 \[High\]:** The system shall provide POST /api/upload/create that accepts title, description, categoryTags, timePerQuestion, questions, and optional gameImage.  
* **REQ-UPLOAD-006 \[High\]:** Each question object shall contain questionText, options (A/B/C/D), correctOption, and optional \_EN bilingual variants.  
* **REQ-UPLOAD-007 \[High\]:** The system shall allow Uploaders to upload a game cover image via POST /api/upload/image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP).  
* **REQ-UPLOAD-008 \[High\]:** Upon successful quiz creation, the system shall store the quiz record with status \= 'published' and created\_by \= userId 

  3. ## **Quiz Module \- Real‑Time Quiz Session Management**

**4.3.1 Description and Priority**

This feature delivers timed, sequential questions to participants, records answers in real time, calculates scores, and manages the lifecycle of a quiz session.

**Priority:** **High** – This is the core interactive experience.

**4.3.2 Stimulus/Response Sequences (Detailed)4.3.3 Functional Requirements**

* **REQ-QUIZ-001 \[High\]:** The system shall allow an authenticated participant to start a quiz and receive randomized questions via GET /api/quizzes/:id/questions.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-002 \[High\]:** Questions shall be returned in a random order (ORDER BY RAND()) unique to each request to reduce cheating.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-003 \[High\]:** The system shall support bilingual question display (ID/EN) controlled by a ?lang= query parameter.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-004 \[High\]:** The frontend shall maintain a per-participant countdown timer based on the quiz time\_limit.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-005 \[High\]:** When the timer reaches zero without an answer, the system shall automatically treat the answer as incorrect and advance to the next question.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-006 \[High\]:** Upon submitting an answer, the system shall compare the selected option with correct\_option and calculate the score (+1,000 points per correct answer).  
* **REQ-QUIZ-007 \[High\]:** The system shall show immediate visual feedback (green/red overlay) and audio feedback after each answer.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-008 \[High\]:** The system shall display a streak combo animation for ≥3 consecutive correct answers.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-009 \[High\]:** Upon answering the last question, the system shall submit the score via POST /api/quizzes/:id/submit.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-010 \[High\]:** The system shall prevent a participant from submitting a score for a quiz they already completed (UNIQUE KEY on user\_id \+ quiz\_id).  
* **REQ-QUIZ-011 \[High\]:** The system shall prevent a participant from playing a quiz they created.  
* **REQ-QUIZ-012 \[High\]:** The system shall provide GET /api/quizzes/:id/check to verify if a user has already completed a specific quiz.

  4. **Leaderboard Module – Scoring and Ranking**

**4.4.1 Description and Priority**

This feature computes and displays rankings for each quiz and provides participants with historical performance data.

**Priority:** **High** – Essential for the competitive, gamified experience.

**4.4.2 Functional Requirements**

* **REQ-LEAD-001 \[High\]:** The system shall provide GET /api/quizzes/:id/leaderboard that returns a sorted list of participants with username, score, time\_taken, and avatar.  
* **REQ-LEAD-002 \[High\]:** The leaderboard shall be sorted by score descending. In case of a tie, the participant with lower time\_taken ranks higher.  
* **REQ-LEAD-003 \[High\]:** The system shall provide GET /api/quizzes/leaderboard/global that returns the top 50 players across all quizzes with total\_score, quizzes\_taken, and avg\_score.  
* **REQ-LEAD-004 \[High\]:** The system shall provide GET /api/quizzes/history/me that returns the authenticated user's quiz history and summary statistics (total\_quizzes, avg\_score, highest\_score, total\_score).  
* **REQ-LEAD-005 \[High\]:** The top three participants on any leaderboard shall receive visual medal indicators (🥇🥈🥉).  
* **REQ-LEAD-006 \[Medium\]:** The system shall highlight the current user's row in the leaderboard table.

  5. **Administrative Control Panel** 

**4.5.1 Description and Priority**

This feature provides system administrators with tools to manage users, moderate content, and monitor system health.

**Priority:** **Medium** – Not required for initial participant engagement, but critical for long‑term operation.

**4.5.2 Functional Requirements**

**User Management**

* **REQ‑ADMIN‑001 \[High\]:** The system shall provide GET /api/admin/users (admin only) that returns a paginated list of all users with filters by role and search by username/email.  
* **REQ‑ADMIN‑002 \[High\]:** The system shall provide PATCH /api/admin/users/:userId that allows an admin to update a user's role (to 'participant' or 'uploader'). Admin roles cannot be changed.  
* **REQ‑ADMIN‑003 \[Medium\]:** The system shall provide DELETE /api/admin/users/:userId that soft-deletes a user account (sets is\_active \= 0). Admin accounts cannot be deleted.

**Content Moderation**

* **REQ‑ADMIN‑004 \[High\]:** The system shall provide an endpoint GET /admin/quizzes with filters by status and uploader.  
* **REQ‑ADMIN‑005 \[High\]:** The system shall allow an admin to hide a quiz via PATCH /admin/quizzes/:quizId with body { status: 'hidden' }. Hidden quizzes do not appear in participant dashboards but remain in the database.  
* **REQ‑ADMIN‑006 \[Medium\]:** The system shall allow an admin to permanently delete a quiz and all associated scores via DELETE /admin/quizzes/:quizId.

**Reporting**

* **REQ‑ADMIN‑007 \[Low\]:** The system shall provide an endpoint GET /admin/stats that returns:  
  * Total registered users  
  * Total quizzes created  
  * Total quiz attempts  
  * Average score across all attempts  
  * New users per day (last 7 days)  
* **REQ‑ADMIN‑008 \[Medium\]:** All administrative actions (role change, user deactivation, quiz status change, quiz deletion) shall be logged in the audit\_log table with admin\_id, action, target\_type, target\_id, and timestamp.

5. # **Other Nonfunctional Requirements**

   1. ## **Performance Requirements** {#performance-requirements}

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Measurement Method |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **PERF‑01** | The landing page shall load and become interactive within **2.0 seconds** on a 4G network (simulated). | High | Lighthouse performance score ≥90, First Contentful Paint \<1.5s. |
| **PERF‑02** | REST API response time (95th percentile) shall be **≤300 ms** under a load of 50 concurrent users. | High | k6 load test against /quizzes endpoint. |
| **PERF‑03** | WebSocket question:new latency (server emit to client receipt) shall be **≤200 ms** for 95% of events. | High | Instrumented client logging. |
| **PERF‑04** | The system shall support **100 concurrent WebSocket connections** (active quiz participants) without exceeding 70% CPU utilization on the server. | High | Load test with Artillery. |
| **PERF‑05** | Database queries for leaderboard retrieval (top 50\) shall execute in **≤100 ms**. | Medium | MySQL EXPLAIN and query profiling. |

   2. ## **Safety Requirements**

* **SAFE-01 \[High\]:** All communication between client and server shall be encrypted using TLS in production.

* **SAFE-02 \[High\]:** Passwords shall never be logged or transmitted in plaintext. They are hashed using bcryptjs (cost factor 10). 

  3. ## **Security Requirements**

* **SEC-01 \[High\]:** All communication between client and server shall be encrypted using TLS in production.

* **SEC-02 \[High\]:** Passwords shall never be logged or transmitted in plaintext. They are hashed using bcryptjs (cost factor 10). 

* **SEC-03 \[High\]:** JWTs shall be signed using the HS256 algorithm with a secret key stored in environment variables.

* **SEC-04 \[High\]:** The application shall set secure HTTP headers using Helmet.js.

* **SEC-05 \[High\]:** All SQL queries use parameterized statements via mysql2/promise to prevent SQL injection.

* **SEC-06 \[Medium\]:** Rate limiting is applied to authentication endpoints.

  4. ## **Software Quality Attributes**

| Attribute | Requirement | Verification Method |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Usability** | A first-time participant shall be able to register, find a quiz, and complete it within 5 minutes without external help.  | Usability testing with 5 representative users. |
| **Reliability** | The system shall have an uptime of 99.5% during peak hours (9am–9pm) excluding scheduled maintenance.  | Uptime monitoring tool.  |
| **Maintainability** | The backend code shall follow route-based architecture with clear separation of concerns.  | Code review checklist. |
| **Scalability** | The WebSocket layer shall be designed to be extractable into a separate service using Redis adapter in future phases.  | Architecture review. |
| **Testability** | Each REST endpoint shall have at least one integration test covering success and failure scenarios. | Jest test suite coverage report (target \>80%). |

  5. ## **Business Rules**

* **BR-01**: A user may only submit one score per quiz. Implemented via UNIQUE KEY (user\_id, quiz\_id) constraint on the scores table.  
* **BR-02**: The default role for all new registered users is "participant".  
* **BR-03**: The top three participants on any leaderboard shall receive visual medal indicators (🥇🥈🥉).  
* **BR-04**: 14 default game quizzes are pre-seeded into the database via the seeder script (node src/config/seed.js), each with 5 bilingual questions and corresponding cover images.   
* **BR-05**: A quiz creator (Uploader) cannot participate in their own quiz.  
* **BR-06**: Guest users cannot play quizzes \- they are redirected to the login page. 

6. # **Other Requirements**

## **6.1 Pre-Seeded Quiz Content**

The system ships with 14 pre-seeded game quizzes, each containing 5 bilingual (Indonesian \+ English) multiple-choice questions. These quizzes cover various game categories including FPS, RPG, Sandbox, Racing, Simulation, Battle Royale, MOBA, Adventure, Horror, Sports, Rhythm, and Fighting games. Each quiz includes a corresponding cover image stored in uploads/games/

## **6.2 Audio Assets**

All audio files are stored in FrontEnd/public/audio/ and are royalty-free:

* correct.mp3 – Played when the user selects the correct answer   
* wrong.mp3 – Played when the user selects the wrong answer   
* bgm.mp3 – Background music loop during quiz gameplay

## **6.3 Quiz Upload File Format (.txt)**

The structured .txt format is parsed by the server without any AI or external API:

Question: Siapa pencipta Minecraft?

Question\_EN: Who created Minecraft?

A: Markus Persson (Notch)

A\_EN: Markus Persson (Notch)

B: Gabe Newell

B\_EN: Gabe Newell

C: Todd Howard

C\_EN: Todd Howard

D: Steve Jobs

D\_EN: Steve Jobs

Answer: A

**Notes:**

* Minimum 3 questions per quiz (5+ recommended).

* Each question must have exactly 4 options (A, B, C, D) and a correct answer key.

* The \_EN fields are optional — if omitted, the Indonesian version is used for both languages.

* Supported keywords: Question/Q/Pertanyaan (and \_EN variants), A/B/C/D (and \_EN), Answer/Kunci/Ans/Jawaban.
